lines.trans: If there is nothing else I am leaving first; I am very busy.
Meeting today, I wanted to tell you one thing.
From now on, stop planting informants around me.
You saw yesterday's show too; your informant was useless.
Chun Yu, you really are smart.
This is the last time.
Every informant you planted around me, I have already pulled out.
What happened before does not count as a big problem.
But from now on, I hope you do things by the rules.
Your style of working, I know better than anyone.
Old rule: whoever loses pays the bill.
Coming — I will pay the bill!
